display_long_description:
Studio40 is a collection of immersive XR experiences designed to support brain wellness through synchronized light and sound environments inspired by 40Hz gamma-frequency rhythms.

Emerging neuroscience research has explored the role of gamma-frequency brain activity (around 40Hz) in brain wellness. Studio40 translates these scientific insights into thoughtfully designed immersive experiences that include instrumental activities of daily living (IADLs), engaging games that encourage movement and support memory and cognitive engagement, and gentle spaces for meditation, relaxation, and inspiration.

Studio40 experiences are:

• Immersive and distraction-free
• Built around rhythmic sensory design
• Accessible through XR headsets without additional equipment
• Designed to encourage relaxation, engagement, and exploration of brain wellness

Studio40 offers a preview of the broader ReviveXR ecosystem which is designed for facilities.

The platform may be used by individuals interested in brain wellness, caregivers and senior communities exploring immersive engagement tools, and researchers investigating new approaches to non-invasive sensory stimulation.

Safety Note:
Studio40 includes rhythmic visual and audio elements inspired by 40-Hz brain rhythms. Users who have a history of seizures, epilepsy, or sensitivity to flashing or rhythmic light should consult a healthcare professional before use. Stop use if you experience discomfort such as dizziness or nausea.
